comments.body: Hijacking this thread to ask a question. I got a subletting offer from supposedly a JUWO residence (I can't verify if the place is managed by JUWO or not since they don't have a public list of residences). Afaik the JUWO subletting contract does not regulate a deposit/Kaution, but the person who is subletting the room to me is asking for a deposit of 3 months rent. How do I make sure it's not a scam?
comments.author: bozaro_za_rokku
